description:
## Goal

Delete the complete SemanticClosure data model left behind after semantic sealing was removed. No compatibility type or historical re-export remains.

## Proof at a3a9761d1

- `SemanticClosure`, `SemanticClosureSlot`, and `SemanticClosureMap` are defined only in `src/compiler2/semantic.rs`.
- The only external mention is their public re-export from `src/compiler2/mod.rs`.
- No World field stores them, no constructor creates them, and no job or product reads or writes them.
- SealSemanticClosure, SemanticClosed, SemanticReady, MaterializeRoot, and the old closure-definition path are absent from the source tree.

The public re-export suppresses the dead-code signal and makes a removed phase appear architecturally live.

## Change

- Delete all three types and every impl belonging to them.
- Delete their re-exports.
- Remove documentation that names semantic closure sealing or the deleted data model as current behavior.

## TDD and checks

- `rg SemanticClosure src tests .agent northstar.html` returns no live implementation or current-model reference.
- Existing semantic, artifact, and product tests remain green without replacement scaffolding.
- Full library, single-threaded fixture matrix, and clippy with warnings denied pass.

No new abstraction replaces these types; their absence is the result.
title: Delete the orphaned SemanticClosure data model
